dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Dolphins (1-9) Week 12 Briefing: Injury Updates Ahead of Jets
bullets: Roster & Front Office: Miami signed P Jack Browning from the practice squad to the active roster. Signed DE Max Llewellyn to the practice squad [Miami Dolphins Official](https://www.miamidolphins.com/team/transactions/#tx-f7f351f4753a).

Injury & Practice Status: Entering Week 12 preparation, head coach Jeff Hafley and the medical staff evaluate P Bradley Pinion (groin), WR Jared Wayne (quadriceps), S Dante Trader Jr. (shoulder), and WR Chris Bell (knee) ahead of Wednesday's initial participation report. LB Ronnie Harrison Jr. (hamstring) continue ramping inside active 21-day Injured Reserve practice windows toward potential 53-man roster activation [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-preview-2026-new-york-jets-vs-miami-dolphins).

Week 12 Jets Outlook: Jeff Hafley and DC Sean Duggan open installation for the New York Jets (3-8, NYJ -3.5, HC Aaron Glenn, OC Frank Reich & DC Brian Duker (Hard Rock Stadium))—a unit ranked #4 in Pass Yards Allowed / Gm (188.3 yds) as Miami prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [miamidolphins.com Official](https://www.miamidolphins.com/news/aqua-archives-home-history-vs-the-jets) [ProFootballTalk](https://www.nbcsports.com/watch/nfl/profootballtalk/pft-pm/pft-week-12-preview-2026-new-york-jets-vs-miami-dolphins).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 1-9 (4th in AFC East • #15 Seed in AFC), Miami carries a 0% postseason projection, 0% AFC East division title mark, and 0% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [James McKinney](https://www.thephinsider.com/miami-dolphins-discussion/125260/miami-dolphins-discussion-week-12-game-vs-ny-jets-predictions-edition).
